requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

661-803-1486-4231--108--119.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Arcane Adaptation, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Sculpting Steel. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Arcane Adaptation, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

2226-2499-2805.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control tap for at least {2}{R}{G}{W} plus half the cost of your self-bouncing creature.
2226-2499-2805.description:
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Cast Zacama either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {6}{R}{G}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Zacama enters, its ability triggers twice through Yarok.
Resolve the first Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Activate all mana-producing lands you control by tapping them.
Resolve the second Zacama trigger, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Kiri-Onna by paying its mana cost.
When Kiri-Onna enters, its ability triggers twice, causing you to return itself and Zacama to your hand.
Repeat.

1479-5478-5700-5701-8293.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1479-5478-5700-5701-8293.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Cleveland Booker trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield untapped as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Cleveland Booker trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Cleveland Booker triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

4279-5075-6634--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
4279-5075-6634--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Al Bhed Salvagers triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

4452-4881-6909-7884.manaNeeded: {1}{W}{U} plus {2}{B} if Activated Sleeper is in your hand
4452-4881-6909-7884.description:
Cast Sygg's Command by paying its mana cost, creating a token copy of Carnage.
Put the nontoken Carnage into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Carnage token enters, it triggers, putting Activated Sleeper from your graveyard onto the battlefield, or another applicable card otherwise.
If Activated Sleeper was not returned in step 3, cast it by paying {2}{B}. Regardless, choose to have Activated Sleeper enter as a copy of Carnage.
Put Activated Sleeper into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When Activated Sleeper enters, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Carnage.
Repeat from step 5.

1479-2841-7705-8101.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Wooded Foothills.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1479-2841-7705-8101.description:
Fetch a land using Wooded Foothills.
When the fetched land enters, Mole Man and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Mole Man trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mole Man from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Mole Man triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

645-804-1267-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
Alesha does not have summoning sickness.
645-804-1267-8095.description:
Declare Alesha as an attacker.
Alesha triggers, causing you to pay {U/B}{U/B} to return Sakashima the Impostor from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking as a nonlegendary copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage using Sakashima the Impostor.
Sakashima the Impostor triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sakashima the Impostor
Repeat each turn.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-6972-7727.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Hulk.
When Hulk dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

1981-2415-2921-4476.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-2921-4476.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

4153-6798--5--195.notablePrerequisites: At least one persist creature has a +1/+1 counter on it.
4153-6798--5--195.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Resourceful Defense trigger.
Resolve Resourceful Defense's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability from step 1.
Repeat.

215-1129-1753.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Allies.
215-1129-1753.description:
Activate Harabaz Druid by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Harabaz Druid from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Harabaz Druid by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1619-2034-4605-5542-6145.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6145.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Passageway Seer from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Passageway Seer enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Passageway Seer.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Passageway Seer token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Passageway Seer token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Passageway Seer that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Passageway Seer trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-2034-4605-5542-6145.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

3185-5256-6972.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Evernight Shade
When Evernight Shade dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Evernight Shade enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 4.
3185-5256-6972.notes: If Evernight Shade starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 4 instead.

64-2103-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Warden of the Eye and exiling Ephemerate.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Warden of the Eye.
When Warden of the Eye enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

240-1753-4050-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing an Egg token, adding one mana of any color
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

296-3532-5078-5901.easyPrerequisites:
There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
296-3532-5078-5901.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
The Thirteenth Doctor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

1479-2841-6156-6662.easyPrerequisites:
It is not your turn.
There is a land card in your library that can be fetched using Bad River.
1479-2841-6156-6662.description:
Fetch a land using Bad River.
When the fetched land enters, Chocobo Racetrack and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Kodama and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Holding priority, activate Ghost Town's first abiltiy by tapping it, adding {C}.
Activate Ghost Town's second ability by paying {0}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack from step 4, creating a token.
When the token enters, Kodama triggers, putting Ghost Town from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Ghost Town enters, Chocobo Racetrack triggers.
Repeat from step 5.

uses.n: The Legend of Kuruk // Avatar Kuruk

4013-5902-7009.manaNeeded: {2}{C} plus an additional {20} minus {1} for each creature and artifact you control each turn available
4013-5902-7009.description:
Activate Avatar Kuruk by paying {20} minus {1} for each creature and/or artifact you can tap while activating it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Avatar Kuruk and causing it to return to the battlefield as The Legend of Kuruk with two lore counters on it due to Innkeeper's Talent.
The Legend of Kuruk's first and second chapter abilities trigger, causing you to scry 2, draw a card, scry 2 and draw another card.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your precombat main phase. The Legend of Kuruk triggers, putting two lore counters on it. Its third chapter ability triggers, causing you to exile it and return it to the battlefield as Avatar Kuruk.
Repeat.

2866-3200-4659-4986.description:
Cast Urza's Bauble by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Urza's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Urza's Bauble from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

955-1563-2457-3000.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

152-2034-3000-5446.description:
Activate Cogwork Assembler by paying {7}, creating a token copy of Esika's Chariot and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Esika's Chariot token enters, it triggers, creating two 2/2 Cat creature tokens and two 1/1 Squirrel creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar four times by sacrificing four Cats and Squirrels, adding eight {C}.
Repeat.
152-2034-3000-5446.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may forego sacrificing the Cats or Squirrels and/or target any other artifact using Cogwork Assembler.

2457-3129-4289-6633.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate two Insects by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

325-1742-5796-6282.easyPrerequisites:
Your life total is at least 2.
You have at least one card in hand.
325-1742-5796-6282.notablePrerequisites: You have at least eight permanent cards in your graveyard.
325-1742-5796-6282.description:
Activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Toluz's second ability triggers, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Starving Revenant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and an opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

500-851-2523-6441.description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Adrix and Nev and creating four token copies of it with base power equal to half the destroyed creature's power and base toughness equal to half the destroyed creature's toughness, rounding up each time.
Put all but one Adrix and Nev token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Ratadrabik triggers four times from the nontoken and token Adrix and Nevs dying.
Resolve the first trigger, creating 2^X nonlegendary token copies of Adrix and Nev that are 2/2 Zombies, where X is the number of Adrix and Nevs you control plus one.
Repeat step 4 for the remaining triggers.
500-851-2523-6441.notes: Assuming you control no other token doublers, this combo will make a total of 10^(10^308.0343553279263) creature tokens.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control that doesn't have summoning sickness

27-3259-4478.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
27-3259-4478.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Furnace-Blessed Conqueror as attackers.
Furnace-Blessed Conqueror triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

262-3076-4050.notablePrerequisites:
Sleep-Cursed Faerie does not have summoning sickness, and does not have a stun counter on it.
Elemental Mastery attached to Sleep-Cursed Faerie.
262-3076-4050.description:
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by tapping it, creating three 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing two Elementals, adding {1}{U}.
Activate Sleep-Cursed Faerie by paying {1}{U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

3360-4289-4944.notablePrerequisites: Torchling does not have summoning sickness.
3360-4289-4944.description:
Activate Torchling by tapping it, adding {R}.
Activate Torchling's first ability by paying {R}.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Torchling ability, untapping it.
Repeat.

2292-4191-4616-5010.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Golgari Thug.
When Golgari Thug dies, it and Moldervine Reclamation trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Thug trigger, putting it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Moldervine Reclamation trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and draw Golgari Thug from the top of your library.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Golgari Thug by paying {0} due to Aluren.
Repeat.

2143-4365.description:
Activate Spawnsire of Ulamog by paying {4}, creating four 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawns by sacrificing them, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

198-915-2722.notablePrerequisites:
Synod Artificer does not have summoning sickness.
Empowered Autogenerator has at least two charge counters on it.
198-915-2722.description:
Activate Empowered Autogenerator by tapping it, putting a charge counter on it and adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Synod Artificer's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Empowered Autogenerator and Magewright's Stone.
Activate Magewright's Stone by paying {1} and tapping it, untapping Synod Artificer.
Repeat.

1371-3094-3367.description:
Cast Paradigm Shift by paying {1}{U}, triggering Hive Mind.
Holding priority, activate Lithoform Engine's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, copying Hive Mind's trigger.
Resolve the Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to copy Paradigm Shift twice.
Resolve each Paradigm Shift copy, exiling your opponent' libraries.
Resolve the original Paradigm Shift, exiling your library and putting your graveyard into your library.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1645-1765-5231.description:
Cast Crown of Flames by paying {R}, targeting any creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}.
Crown of Flames enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating a 2/2 Spirit creature token.
Activate Thermopod's second ability by sacrificing the Spirit, adding {R}.
Activate Crown of Flames' second ability by paying {R}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-4474-4893-5153.notablePrerequisites:
Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
Paradise Mantle attached to Sunstrike Legionnaire.
2457-4474-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 1/1 Insect token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
